verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that API requests use a Bearer token and that Notte offers vaults that keep website credentials hidden from LLMs. Vaults are an adjacent feature for storing third-party logins, not a way to issue scoped or least-privilege Notte API keys for an agent. Nothing in the pack documents per-key scopes, permission restrictions, or agent-specific API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
